title: Graph Transformer for Retrieval
abstract: We combine graph transformer blocks with retrieval augmentation for robust document ranking in low resource settings.

title: Lightweight Baseline for Citation Intent
abstract: This baseline uses sparse lexical overlap and simple section statistics for citation intent prediction.

title: Multimodal Knowledge Distillation
abstract: The model aligns figure captions tables and abstract tokens through multimodal knowledge distillation.

title: Rule Driven Document Tagging
abstract: We study a rule driven pipeline for document tagging without deep contextual encoders.

title: Temporal Contrastive Pretraining for Papers
abstract: Temporal contrastive objectives improve scientific paper representations across yearly snapshots.

title: Classical Feature Engineering for Abstract Classification
abstract: The system relies on tf style counts handcrafted metadata and shallow validation heuristics.

title: Robust Benchmark for Long Scientific Documents
abstract: We release a robust benchmark for long scientific documents and hierarchical retrieval evaluation.

title: Keyword Heuristics for Venue Prediction
abstract: This work predicts venue categories with keyword heuristics and a compact decision routine.
